title: TMBB spaceships X account suspected to be McCasland

tellings.quote: After his story broke, an online manhunt zeroed in on a potential smoking gun, an exac account called TMBB spaceships.

plain: In 2026, after the story of a man named McCasland broke, people online hunted for clues and settled on an account on X, the social network, called "TMBB spaceships", which they suspected was his. Michels tells this himself and calls the account a "potential smoking gun". He draws on McCasland's official Air Force biography alongside it. If the account was his, it would tie a former Air Force man to public posts about spaceships.
